title: Integrity and ethical values
summary: The organisation shows commitment to integrity and ethics through a code of conduct that people acknowledge and that is enforced.
typical_evidence: Code of conduct; signed acknowledgements for sampled hires; disciplinary policy

title: Board oversight
summary: A board or equivalent body independent of management oversees internal control and security.
typical_evidence: Board or advisory charter; minutes showing security updates; org chart

title: Structure, authority and responsibility
summary: Management sets reporting lines, authorities and responsibilities for security and compliance.
typical_evidence: Org chart; security roles and responsibilities document; job descriptions

title: Commitment to competence
summary: The organisation attracts, develops and retains competent people in line with its objectives.
typical_evidence: Hiring process; background check records; training records; performance reviews

title: Accountability
summary: People are held accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
typical_evidence: Performance review records; disciplinary policy; policy acknowledgements

title: Quality information
summary: The organisation obtains or produces relevant and quality information to support internal control.
typical_evidence: System inventory; data flow diagrams; monitoring dashboards; log retention settings

title: Internal communication
summary: Security objectives and responsibilities are communicated internally including a way to report concerns.
typical_evidence: Security awareness training completion; policy portal; whistleblower or reporting channel

title: External communication
summary: The organisation communicates with customers and other outside parties about security commitments and changes.
typical_evidence: Terms of service; trust page; customer contracts or MSA template; status page; incident notification process

title: Objectives for risk
summary: Objectives are specified clearly enough to identify and assess risks.
typical_evidence: Security objectives; risk management policy

title: Risk identification and analysis
summary: Risks to objectives are identified and analysed across the entity.
typical_evidence: Risk assessment for the period; risk register with likelihood and impact

title: Fraud risk
summary: Fraud risk is considered when assessing risks.
typical_evidence: Risk register entries covering fraud; segregation of duties analysis

title: Changes that affect internal control
summary: Significant changes in the business or environment are identified and assessed for risk.
typical_evidence: Risk assessment updates after major changes; change impact notes

title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
summary: Controls are evaluated through ongoing monitoring or separate evaluations such as internal audits.
typical_evidence: Internal audit report; control self-assessment; continuous monitoring results

title: Communicating deficiencies
summary: Control deficiencies are communicated to those responsible and to management in a timely way.
typical_evidence: Findings tracker with owners and due dates; management review notes

title: Control activities to mitigate risk
summary: Control activities are selected and developed to reduce risks to acceptable levels.
typical_evidence: Risk treatment plan mapping risks to controls; control matrix

title: Technology general controls
summary: General controls over technology are selected and developed.
typical_evidence: Control matrix covering access; change; operations; IT policies

title: Policies and procedures
summary: Controls are deployed through policies and procedures that are communicated and followed.
typical_evidence: Approved information security policy set with review dates; acknowledgements

title: Logical access security
summary: Logical access to systems and data is restricted using identity management; authentication such as MFA; encryption and network controls.
typical_evidence: IdP MFA policy export; SSO app list; org 2FA requirement; encryption at rest settings; network security groups

title: User registration and authorisation
summary: New users are registered and authorised before access is granted and access is removed when no longer needed.
typical_evidence: Access request tickets for sampled joiners; onboarding checklist; deprovisioning records

title: Role-based access and changes
summary: Access is granted modified and removed based on roles; least privilege and segregation of duties; periodic access reviews.
typical_evidence: Role definitions; quarterly access review records; IAM policy and role assignment exports

title: Physical access
summary: Physical access to facilities and data centres is restricted to authorised people.
typical_evidence: Cloud provider SOC 2 report (inherited); office access control logs; visitor log

title: Asset disposal
summary: Data and software are removed from assets before disposal and protection continues until removal.
typical_evidence: Device disposal or wipe records; media sanitisation procedure; cloud provider report

title: Protection against external threats
summary: Logical access controls protect against threats from outside the system boundary.
typical_evidence: Firewall or security group rules; WAF configuration; public access blocks; VPN or zero-trust config

title: Data transmission and movement
summary: Movement of data is restricted to authorised users and processes and protected in transit.
typical_evidence: TLS configuration; DLP settings; MDM policies; data transfer procedure

title: Malicious software prevention
summary: Controls prevent or detect unauthorised or malicious software.
typical_evidence: Endpoint protection console export; MDM compliance report; software install restrictions

title: Configuration and vulnerability monitoring
summary: Detection and monitoring identify configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.
typical_evidence: Vulnerability scan results; Dependabot or code-scanning alerts; AWS Config or equivalent; patch records

title: Anomaly monitoring
summary: System components are monitored for anomalies that indicate malicious acts or errors.
typical_evidence: Audit logging enabled (CloudTrail etc); alert rules; GuardDuty or SIEM findings; log retention

title: Security event evaluation
summary: Security events are evaluated to decide whether they are incidents.
typical_evidence: Incident response plan; triage records; incident tickets

title: Incident response
summary: Identified incidents are responded to through a defined programme to contain remediate and communicate.
typical_evidence: Incident response plan; incident tickets and postmortems; tabletop exercise record

title: Incident recovery
summary: Activities are run to recover from identified incidents.
typical_evidence: Postmortems with recovery actions; restore records; lessons learned

title: Change management
summary: Changes to infrastructure software and data are authorised designed tested approved and implemented in a controlled way.
typical_evidence: Branch protection and required reviews; sampled pull requests with approvals; CI test runs; change policy

title: Business disruption risk
summary: Risk mitigation activities address potential business disruption.
typical_evidence: Business continuity plan; disaster recovery plan; insurance; BCP test

title: Vendor and partner risk
summary: Risks from vendors and business partners are assessed and managed.
typical_evidence: Vendor inventory; vendor risk assessments; vendor SOC 2 reports; DPAs

title: Capacity management
summary: Current processing capacity is maintained and monitored and future capacity is planned.
typical_evidence: Capacity or autoscaling configuration; utilisation dashboards; alert thresholds

title: Environmental protections and backups
summary: Environmental protections software data backup processes and recovery infrastructure are in place.
typical_evidence: Backup plans and retention settings; multi-AZ or redundancy config; cloud provider report

title: Recovery testing
summary: Recovery plan procedures are tested to support system recovery.
typical_evidence: Backup restore test records; DR test report

title: Identify and maintain confidential information
summary: Confidential information is identified and protected according to confidentiality commitments.
typical_evidence: Data classification policy; data inventory; NDAs; encryption settings

title: Dispose of confidential information
summary: Confidential information is disposed of to meet confidentiality commitments.
typical_evidence: Data retention and deletion policy; deletion records; customer offboarding deletion

title: Processing specifications
summary: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant quality information about processing objectives and definitions of data processed.
typical_evidence: Product specifications; data definitions; API documentation

title: Input controls
summary: Inputs are complete and accurate in line with processing objectives.
typical_evidence: Input validation design; error handling; reconciliation reports

title: Processing controls
summary: Processing is complete accurate and timely in line with specifications.
typical_evidence: Job monitoring; automated tests; reconciliation and exception reports

title: Output controls
summary: Outputs are complete accurate distributed only to intended parties and timely.
typical_evidence: Output review procedures; access restrictions on reports; delivery logs

title: Storage of inputs and outputs
summary: Stored inputs items in processing and outputs are complete accurate and protected.
typical_evidence: Database integrity controls; backups; retention settings

title: Privacy notice
summary: Notice about privacy practices is provided to data subjects and kept current.
typical_evidence: Published privacy policy with version history

title: Choice and consent
summary: Choices about collection use retention disclosure and disposal are communicated and consent is obtained where needed.
typical_evidence: Consent flows; cookie banner config; consent records

title: Collection limited to purpose
summary: Personal information is collected only for the purposes identified in the notice.
typical_evidence: Data inventory against notice; product data collection review

title: Explicit consent for collection
summary: Explicit consent is obtained where required before collecting personal information.
typical_evidence: Consent records; signup flow screenshots

title: Use limited to purpose
summary: Personal information is used only for the purposes identified in the notice.
typical_evidence: Records of processing; purpose mapping

title: Retention
summary: Personal information is retained only as long as needed for the stated purposes.
typical_evidence: Retention schedule; TTL or lifecycle settings

title: Disposal
summary: Personal information is disposed of securely in line with objectives.
typical_evidence: Deletion procedure; deletion job logs

title: Access by data subjects
summary: Data subjects can access their personal information for review.
typical_evidence: Data subject request procedure; DSR tickets

title: Correction by data subjects
summary: Data subjects can update or correct their personal information.
typical_evidence: Correction procedure; DSR tickets

title: Disclosure to third parties
summary: Personal information is disclosed to third parties only for identified purposes and with consent where needed.
typical_evidence: Subprocessor list; DPAs; disclosure records

title: Record of authorised disclosures
summary: Authorised disclosures are recorded completely and accurately.
typical_evidence: Disclosure log

title: Record of unauthorised disclosures
summary: Unauthorised disclosures including breaches are recorded.
typical_evidence: Breach register; incident tickets

title: Third-party commitments
summary: Commitments are obtained from vendors with access to personal information and their compliance is checked.
typical_evidence: DPAs; vendor assessments

title: Third-party breach notification
summary: Vendors are required to report unauthorised disclosures to the entity.
typical_evidence: DPA breach notification clauses

title: Breach notification to data subjects
summary: Affected data subjects and regulators are notified of breaches as required.
typical_evidence: Breach notification procedure; notification records

title: Accounting of disclosures
summary: Data subjects can obtain an accounting of disclosures of their personal information.
typical_evidence: Disclosure accounting procedure

title: Quality of personal information
summary: Personal information is kept accurate complete and relevant.
typical_evidence: Data quality procedures; correction mechanisms

title: Privacy inquiries and complaints
summary: A process exists to receive address and monitor privacy inquiries complaints and disputes.
typical_evidence: Privacy contact; complaint log; response records
